health_events.description: Recent SICK / INJURED notes from the Intervals calendar and how they shaped readiness.

return_protocol.description: extended = illness of 7+ days or covid/flu/fever: staged return-to-play.

red_flags.description: Medical red flags (chest pain/tightness, palpitations, disproportionate breathlessness, dizziness/fainting, fever, below-the-neck illness) from the check-in, its structured red_flags/illness_symptoms fields and Intervals activity notes. Any entry forces red readiness, rest or walking only and a see-a-doctor message.

training_clearance.description: easy_only = above-the-neck symptoms (neck check); no_training_see_doctor = any red flag, fever or below-the-neck illness.

no_impact_areas.description: Body parts with a check-in pain score of 5/10 or more: no impact loading on that area this week.

energy_availability_concern.description: Weight trend / low-energy-availability concern passed to the nutritionist.

return_from_break.description: Echo of normalized_snapshot.training_load.return_from_break as interpreted by the doctor.

positive_findings.description: Signals that earned readiness points back (HRV above band, RHR below baseline, high subjective readiness, quality sessions felt strong).

underload.description: Underload assessment from normalized_snapshot.training_load.underload, as interpreted by the doctor.

intensity_allowance.description: Ceiling of genuine quality sessions readiness supports this week; the head coach decides the actual number.
